Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) is the current standard second-line therapy for human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive metastatic breast cancer (MBC), and it has been recently approved by FDA as first line therapy in combination with pertuzumab, following the results of the DESTINY-Breast09 trial. However, optimal treatment strategies following T-DXd remain undefined and data on subsequent therapies are limited.
